- [skip](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/operations/directives/skip.md): Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the if argument is true.

- [ThreadComment](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/thread-comment.md): Forum Thread Comment
- [ThreadCommentLikeNotification](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/thread-comment-like-notification.md): Notification for when a thread comment is liked
- [ThreadCommentMentionNotification](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/thread-comment-mention-notification.md): Notification for when authenticated user is @ mentioned in a forum thread comment
- [ThreadCommentReplyNotification](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/thread-comment-reply-notification.md): Notification for when a user replies to your forum thread comment
- [ThreadCommentSubscribedNotification](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/thread-comment-subscribed-notification.md): Notification for when a user replies to a subscribed forum thread
- [ThreadLikeNotification](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/thread-like-notification.md): Notification for when a thread is liked
- [User](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user.md): A user
- [UserActivityHistory](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-activity-history.md): A user's activity history stats for the previous 6 months. Refreshes only periodically
- [UserAvatar](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-avatar.md): A user's avatars
- [UserCountryStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-country-statistic.md): No description
- [UserFormatStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-format-statistic.md): No description
- [UserGenreStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-genre-statistic.md): No description
- [UserLengthStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-length-statistic.md): No description
- [UserModData](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-mod-data.md): User data for moderators
- [UserOptions](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-options.md): A user's general options
- [UserPreviousName](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-previous-name.md): A user's previous name
- [UserReleaseYearStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-release-year-statistic.md): No description
- [UserScoreStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-score-statistic.md): No description
- [UserStaffStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-staff-statistic.md): No description
- [UserStartYearStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-start-year-statistic.md): No description
- [UserStatisticTypes](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-statistic-types.md): No description
- [UserStatistics](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-statistics.md): No description
- [UserStats](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-stats.md): A user's statistics
- [UserStatusStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-status-statistic.md): No description
- [UserStudioStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-studio-statistic.md): No description
- [UserTagStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-tag-statistic.md): No description
- [UserVoiceActorStatistic](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/user-voice-actor-statistic.md): No description
- [YearStats](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/objects/year-stats.md): User's year statistics
- [Boolean](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/scalars/boolean.md): The Boolean scalar type represents true or false.
- [CountryCode](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/scalars/country-code.md): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code
- [Float](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/scalars/float.md): The Float scalar type represents signed double-precision fractional values as specified by IEEE 754.
- [FuzzyDateInt](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/scalars/fuzzy-date-int.md): 8 digit long date integer (YYYYMMDD). Unknown dates represented by 0. E.g. 2016: 20160000, May 1976: 19760500
- [Int](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/scalars/int.md): The Int scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.
- [Json](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/scalars/json.md)
- [String](https://graphql-markdown.dev/raw/docs/types/scalars/string.md): The String scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.
